add.q: Assertion (A): The base of a dam is made much broader than its top. Reason (R): Liquid pressure at a given depth depends mainly on the shape of the container holding the liquid, not on the height of the liquid column above that point. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
